text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and interpret text in a useful way. For example, NLP makes it possible to translate languages quickly and correctly. It is also used for sentiment analysis, which means finding out if a piece of text is positive, negative or neutral. Many companies use NLP to build chatbots that can answer customer questions. These chatbots understand what people write and reply in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, computers can now communicate with us more easily than ever before.
